job.title: Senior Product Manager E-Commerce - VacanceSelect Travel - Breda

tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, data modeling and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and e-commerce channels. Experienced in agile delivery, working directly with business and international technical teams to optimize e-commerce platforms and user journeys. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Product Manager E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: Driving digital customer journeys and high-performing e-commerce platforms is at the core of my 5+ years of engineering enterprise solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am excited by VacanceSelect Travel's mission to optimize the booking journey across five distinct brands and deliver seamless digital experiences.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Platform & Journey Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud for enterprise platforms, directly supporting catalog, pricing, customer data management, and optimized booking and customer journeys.

bullets.label: API Integrations & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines to keep multi-channel product catalogs and pricing synchronized across global e-commerce environments.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional capacity bridging business stakeholders and development teams, analysing requirements, writing user stories, and translating commercial goals into robust digital platform features.

bullets.label: Performance & Conversion Focus
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and API migrations that reduced response latency, optimized transaction speed, and improved system stability and conversion-critical workflows.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid German work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am currently serving a notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical and analytical background aligns with your team.

tailoring.why_company: VacanceSelect Travel combines the agility of a scale-up with the reach of five established travel brands, offering a compelling environment to optimize the digital customer journey. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell to help bridge commercial goals with robust platform execution for hundreds of thousands of travelers across Europe.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional expertise at Rockwell Automation and Shell to VacanceSelect Travel, helping optimize digital customer journeys and platform performance across your five brands.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Hiring Team, with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I build high-performing digital platforms and customer journeys. I've applied for the Senior Product Manager E-Commerce role and would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Product Manager E-Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Product Manager E-Commerce position at VacanceSelect Travel. With over 5 years of professional experience building and optimizing enterprise e-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong techno-functional expertise, data-driven integration skills, and close collaboration with international development teams.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
